Subject: RFI for SI-MP-0005 Precision coolant bracket — supporting evidence requested (SUP-05)

Hello,

Thank you for your packet for SI-MP-0005. Please send supporting evidence for the following items:

1. 1.internal_audit — Internal audit program: procedure and recent audit records.
2. 1.capa — Documented corrective-action (CAPA) process: procedure and example records.
3. 1.calibration — Calibration program covering production gauges: procedure and calibration records.
4. 2.pfmea — Current process failure-mode analysis (PFMEA) for this part.
5. 2.spc — SPC in use on the CTQs now: control charts and reaction plan.
6. 3.inspection_method — Inspection method used for the CTQ tolerances (for example CMM), with equipment identified.
7. 5.lot_trace — Lot or serial traceability to raw material: procedure and a sample trace record.
8. 5.nc_segregation — Nonconforming material identification and segregation: procedure and records.

Stark Industries Supplier Quality — Pepper Potts

audit_plan.question: Quality manual §1.1 states an internal audit program. Ask to see the audit schedule, the most recent audit reports and closure of findings.
Quality manual §1.2 states a corrective-action program. Sample recent CAPA records from open to closure, including root cause and effectiveness check.
Quality manual §1.3 states a gauge calibration program. Check calibration status and certificates for the gauges used on the datum bore, base thickness and hole pitch.
